text:
Jordan Miles: FYI final loop candidate Taylor W flying in today, interview 6:15pm-8:30pm. Need travel + onsite plan.
Priya K.: ETA? coming from out of town?
Jordan Miles: flight lands 4:50pm, should clear by ~5:20. They prefer a quiet hotel single night.
Noah Chen: we can book Elmwood Inn corporate rate. quiet wing, rate $185/night. Approve?
Anika Rao: approve the hotel. Use corporate card.
Reception: After-hours visitor protocol: drop at West Lobby C, bring ID. Call desk at +1-555-901-1222 on arrival. We'll pre-print a badge.
Jordan Miles: can someone meet them? I'd prefer an ops person meet at 5:40 in lobby.
Priya K.: I can meet at 5:40. Adding meetup to calendar.
People Ops Bot: Badge request submitted for Taylor West. Badge ETA: 15 minutes after check-in. After-hours door code sent to meeting attendees only.
Noah Chen: also reserving a quiet interview room (Conf B2) + whiteboard.
Anika Rao: panelists please confirm whether you need a remote dial-in fallback.
Jordan Miles: Zoom backup created and link added to invite.
Reception: When Taylor arrives, please text "Taylor West - arrived" to +1-555-901-1222 for fast tracking.
Priya K.: travel voucher option up to $50 for rideshare or we can pre-book a car. Taylor prefers rideshare usually.
Jordan Miles: please DM Taylor ride instructions and expense email: expenses@redwood.ai with subject "Candidate Travel - Taylor West - [date]". Reimburse within 3 business days.
Noah Chen: catering note: Taylor is vegetarian, also flagged gluten-free. Kitchen will provide boxed dinner.
People Ops Bot: Expense template reminder: "Expense Type: Candidate Travel; Amount: $XX; Candidate: Taylor West; Approver: Jordan Miles".
Priya K.: booking hotel now, will post confirmation to calendar and add folio link.
Reception: We will hold a guest parking permit for one vehicle; let us know plate if they'll have a car.
Anika Rao: panel confirmed. If candidate delayed >30m we will switch to remote.
Jordan Miles: assigning escort: Priya will meet and escort to Conf B2. Thanks everyone.
People Ops Bot: This thread will auto-archive in 7 days per channel policy.
